Screenshot of Settings > About Phone showing the model number.
Close-up photos of the front screen, sides, ports, and buttons.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Samsung Galaxy S10e from photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working, unverified unit; the seller's mint and USA claims are unproven and would require proof to raise the value.
